items.note: Wikipedia: built 1824, transitional Georgian/Greek Revival, one of few with intact slave galleries, about 4 miles north of Pritchardville; NRHP 10 Nov 1987; NRHP county list gives location as SC Highway 170, Pritchardville. Now St. Luke's Methodist, also Bull Hill Church.

faq_candidates.question: Is Pritchardville part of Bluffton, Hardeeville or unincorporated Beaufort County, and does that change who I call about my roof?
faq_candidates.why_this_town: Pritchardville is an unincorporated crossroads between Hardeeville and Bluffton on SC 46.
answer_facts: Wikipedia: unincorporated community in Beaufort County between Hardeeville and Bluffton on SC 46. SC 46 east of Pritchardville is named May River Road and runs into the Town of Bluffton. Borders on both the excluded annexation and permit topics - Paul to decide.

faq_candidates.question: Are the older homes and churches around Pritchardville historic, and does that affect roof work?
faq_candidates.why_this_town: St. Luke's Church (1824) near Pritchardville is NRHP-listed (1987); Pritchardville was settled by Ohioans per the 1938 WPA guide.
answer_facts: Facts available: St. Luke's NRHP 10 Nov 1987; Pritchardville 'originally built up chiefly by settlers from Ohio' (Wikipedia citing 1938 Federal Writers' Project guide).
